def solve_dp(N):
    # DP[i][0]: number of ways to select a valid subset from {1...i} where i is NOT selected.
    # DP[i][1]: number of ways to select a valid subset from {1...i} where i IS selected.
    
    if N == 0:
        return 1 # Only the empty set
        
    # Initialize for i=1
    # DP[1][0] = 1 ({})
    # DP[1][1] = 1 ({1})
    dp_prev = [1, 1] 
    
    for i in range(2, N + 1):
        # Calculate DP[i][0] (i is NOT selected)
        # i-1 could be selected or not selected.
        dp_current_0 = dp_prev[0] + dp_prev[1]
        
        # Calculate DP[i][1] (i IS selected)
        # i-1 MUST NOT be selected (due to difference 1 constraint).
        dp_current_1 = dp_prev[0]
        
        dp_prev = [dp_current_0, dp_current_1]
        
        print(f"N={i}: DP[i][0]={dp_current_0}, DP[i][1]={dp_current_1}, Total={dp_current_0 + dp_current_1}")
        
    return dp_prev[0] + dp_prev[1]

N = 5
result = solve_dp(N)
print(f"Total ways for N={N}: {result}")
